title: GP Assessment Tool - Optimize Your Migration to Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)

features.name: GP Assessment Tool
features.description: A free online tool that analyzes GP SQL Server data to provide guidance and direction on migration to Business Central. The assessment tool reads data only and does not write or change anything in the GP system.
caveats: Does not require BC license to be already purchased
Recommended to exclude test or sample companies from assessment

features.name: Assessment Report with Module Drill-Down
features.description: The assessment report displays modules and features used in GP, allows drilling into ISV solutions installed, and identifies potential migration risks with detailed recommendations.
caveats: Each risk includes details and recommendations for remediation

features.name: Non-Intrusive Assessment Execution
features.description: The assessment can be run during business hours while other users are working in GP without requiring downtime. It only reads data from the GP SQL Server and never writes or changes anything.
caveats: Requires user with GP SQL Server access
